verdict.rationale: GrowthBook's first-party docs describe adding targeting conditions to rules. These conditions are evaluated against attributes passed into the SDK, and the docs also list "saved groups" (reusable segments) and percentage rollouts as targeting options. Rules override a feature's default value and can be scoped, ramped and scheduled, which covers the core story. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of saved-group/segment management (only a single mention), and independent or hands-on corroboration of attribute-based targeting.
